task.title: Refuse competing mount before topology mutation

events.content: Check competing daemons before write-ahead topology persistence: Check competing daemons before write-ahead topology persistence

raw.question: Check competing daemons before write-ahead topology persistence
raw.chosen: Check competing daemons before write-ahead topology persistence
raw.reasoning: Write-ahead persistence protects starts that are actually proceeding, but a rejected competing start is not a start. Its refusal must precede every catalog and filesystem mutation so failure preserves the running mount's observable configuration.

retrospective.summary: Moved competing-daemon refusal ahead of topology persistence and child initialization; regression proves a rejected scope addition leaves the catalog and filesystem unchanged; full vet and Go suite pass.
